about: The next 50 for outreach after WS-26: companies likely to BUY RiskMandate (banks, insurers, telecoms, health, energy, public bodies, Portuguese corporates), each confirmed on a websummit.com lis26 page (event partners list and speakers list, read on 5 November 2026). Research by conductor@web-summit.silvio. A proposal for data/companies.json, which the conductor keeps. Companies and public roles only. 'why_buyer' says 'sector fit' where no fact was found; some (Backbase, Thought Machine, Comarch, Kyndryl, Publicis Sapient, Aubay) sell to banks as much as they buy, so they are also channels. 'Novo' is assumed to be Novo Nordisk, unverified.

buyers.name: Fidelidade
buyers.attending: confirmed: event partner on websummit.com partners page (lis26)
buyers.why_buyer: Portugal's leading insurer, scouting applied-AI pilots across the group (per its Web Summit listing); a regulated insurer piloting AI needs a record of what each agent may reach and do.

buyers.name: Galp
buyers.attending: confirmed: event partner on websummit.com partners page (lis26)
buyers.why_buyer: Portuguese integrated energy company and critical-infrastructure operator; sector fit.

buyers.attending: confirmed: event partner on websummit.com partners page (lis26); speakers incl. Bernardo Correia, Secretary of State for Digitalisation

buyers.attending: confirmed: event partner on websummit.com partners page (lis26); speaker: its Chairman of the Board
